about.title: Low Battery Town
about.body: A city that's always charging. You don't have to be at 100% to begin — just light up one square.
about.footer: PRESS ENTER · KEEP THE LIGHT ON

tips.heading: Low Battery Town
tips.body: A city that's always charging. You don't have to be at 100% to begin — just light up one square.

tips.heading: Shared Pomodoro
tips.body: The timer starts only when both people hit Start. Focus is lit up one square at a time.

tips.heading: Late-night focus
tips.body: Between 12am and 4am the town shines brightest — every pomodoro earns +10 T-coins.

tips.heading: T-Coin Economy
tips.body: Finish tasks → stack T-coins → unlock music, cats and home décor.
